svg.aria-label: As the sequence grows from 3 to 4 to 5 tokens, the earlier rows of the attention pattern are identical and only the last row is new. In the demo run the full recompute processed 27 rows where only 7 were distinct

text.tspan: Old rows never change, so recomputing them is waste
same numbers as the step before
new row: the only real work
